issues.description:
**Type:** canonical-spec-models
**Problem:** `from_raw_spec` no longer reads its `paddr` argument, so the definitional `slot_vaddr() == frame_to_meta(paddr)` link is lost; `Segment`'s `peek`/`remaining` (`segment.rs:946-950`, `:967-971`) pass the per-index paddr without requiring `Segment::inv()`. Drop the now-dead parameter at those call sites, or state the relation explicitly (e.g. `requires slot_perm.addr() == frame_to_meta(paddr)`).
issues.rationale: Independent complete body160-173 constructs Frame solely from slot_perm and metadata_perm, never references paddr. Drop unused spec argument; this is redundant model input, not a proven unsafe implementation.
